rationale: Implement DTL-1.2 after Fiscal re-audit: replace flat calibration residual with Wilson size-aware gate; count distinct matches rather than correlated legs; define flat-unit shadow staking and require drawdown backtest before promotion; keep drift thresholds logging-only until historical calibration with winsorized log-loss plus Brier cross-check; structurally exclude REAL_USER_OVERRIDE from promotion evidence; add runtime cutoff assertion and canonical America/Mexico_City dedup/hash normalization; explicitly separate signal-computable markets from real-stake eligibility.
